Callout.Name: Injured Wildlife
Callout.Message: Deer struck by a vehicle, still alive at the roadside.
Callout.Advisory: Animal in the road, traffic slowing.

Script.Line: It is a deer and it is still alive on the verge.
Traffic is slowing right down to look at it.
Nobody has hit it twice. Not yet.

Lines.Approach: It is still on its feet and it is in the road. Drivers are slowing down to look.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
